recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-18537 follow-up is needed; any further operation GET criteria work belongs to later operation-semantics issues such as FHIR-51046.
issue_request: FHIR-18537 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the FHIR-core operations page. It asked to remove the comma in the Operation Request sentence from "are primitive types, and the operation" to "are primitive types and the operation".
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-18537 was found, but commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e ("many typo fixes") changed source/operations.html on 2018-10-10 from "If all the parameters for the operation are primitive types, and the operation" to "If all the parameters for the operation are primitive types and the operation".
additional_context: source/operations.html is an active Operations page referenced by source/hierarchy.xml and linked from documentation. Later commits changed the same GET-invocation prose, including FHIR-25431 terminology cleanup and FHIR-51046's rewrite to "data types with corresponding search types and the operation". Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested comma was already removed in the active source, and later semantic edits left the current wording free of the historical comma issue.
